objects.description: One catalog document — whatever this domain keeps a record of. The document is the whole of it; only the few fields beside it mean the same in every domain.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers.

fields.name: slug
fields.description: Stable URL key for this entry. Fixed at creation — the private notes and the share links hang off it.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The document's human-readable title, shown on its card.

fields.name: summary
fields.description: One-paragraph description for the card, so a listing never parses the document.

fields.name: doc
fields.description: The whole document. Queried in place by path rather than parsed per row, so anything domain-shaped lives in here rather than in a column.

fields.name: visibility
fields.description: Who may read the document: nothing outside review sees a pending one, and a private one needs a live share key.

fields.name: submitted_by
fields.description: What wrote this revision — a run, or a person.

fields.name: approved_at
fields.description: When it last left pending. Cleared whenever the name, summary or document changes, because the reviewed thing no longer exists.

fields.name: publish_at
fields.description: When it goes public. Empty means as soon as it is public; a time still to come keeps every anonymous read answering exactly as for a missing entry until then.

fields.name: dispose_at
fields.description: When its retention ends. Empty means it is kept until somebody deletes it; once the time has passed, the host's scheduled sweep disposes of it the way a delete would.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the row was created.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: When the row was last written.

fields.name: deleted
fields.description: Soft delete. A deleted row is invisible to every read.

indexes.name: slug_live
indexes.description: One live entry per slug. A deleted entry no longer holds its slug.

indexes.name: visibility
indexes.description: Filters the review queue and the public listing.

objects.description: What the operator knows about one entry and no reader of the catalog may see. A separate object because the two have different readers.

fields.name: slug
fields.description: The entry these notes belong to. One row per entry.

fields.name: readme
fields.description: The operator-facing description of the entry.

fields.name: sales
fields.description: The prospect list and open bids, as Markdown. Empty wherever an entry is not something being sold.

fields.name: module_configs
fields.description: Per-module configuration for this entry, keyed by module code. Never leaves the operator surface.

fields.name: appeal
fields.description: One line saying why this ranks where it does.

fields.name: rank
fields.description: Position in the running order, lowest first. Zero means unranked and sorts last.

fields.name: doc
fields.description: The domain's own private content for this entry, as one document. A domain that is not a storefront keeps what only operators may read here, the way every other object in this module carries its own document.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: When these notes were last written.

indexes.name: rank
indexes.description: Orders the catalog for the showcase.

objects.description: One key that opens a private entry. An entry may have many, so a rotation can overlap.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers.

fields.name: slug
fields.description: The entry this key opens.

fields.name: key_hash
fields.description: SHA-256 of the raw key, hex-encoded. The raw key is returned once at issue and never stored.

fields.name: label
fields.description: Optional note about who this link went to.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Whether the key still opens its entry. Retired links are kept rather than deleted, so a rotation leaves a trail.

fields.name: created_by
fields.description: Who issued it.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When it was issued.

fields.name: retired_at
fields.description: When it stopped working. Empty while active.

indexes.name: slug_status
indexes.description: Finds the live keys for one entry, which is what a read checks.

objects.description: A proposal that something is worth adding to the catalog, filed cheaply and waiting on a person before anything is built.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers.

fields.name: slug
fields.description: The slug the entry would take. Checked against the catalog before filing, so the same proposal is never queued twice.

fields.name: title
fields.description: What the entry would be called.

fields.name: why
fields.description: The case for building it.

fields.name: source
fields.description: What filed it.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Where it has got to. Only fulfilling it may set 'built'; the tenth failed attempt stalls it.

fields.name: priority
fields.description: Queue position, lowest first. The gap either side leaves room to reorder without renumbering.

fields.name: attempts
fields.description: How many builds have failed. Cleared when an approval sends a stalled row back for another ten.

fields.name: proposal
fields.description: The sketch a build starts from. Anything domain-shaped belongs in here rather than in a column.

fields.name: run_ref
fields.description: The run that filed it.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When it was filed.

fields.name: decided_at
fields.description: When it was approved or rejected. Empty while proposed.

indexes.name: status_priority
indexes.description: The routine's queue: approved proposals, best priority first.

objects.description: One note on a proposal: a run saying what is left after a failed build, or a person saying why they decided as they did.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers.

fields.name: suggestion_id
fields.description: The proposal this note is about.

fields.name: author
fields.description: Who wrote it: a slug naming a run, a person or a role. 'run' and 'admin' are the module's own.

fields.name: run_ref
fields.description: The run that wrote it, when a run did.

fields.name: attempt
fields.description: Which build attempt this came out of. Zero for a note that is not about an attempt.

fields.name: body
fields.description: The note itself. An attempt without one tells the next run nothing.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When it was written.

indexes.name: suggestion_created
indexes.description: Reads one proposal's notes in order.

objects.description: Records that one entry answers one proposal.

fields.name: suggestion_id
fields.description: The proposal that was met.

fields.name: slug
fields.description: The entry that meets it.

fields.name: run_ref
fields.description: The run that built it.

fields.name: note
fields.description: What the run said about the match.

fields.name: met_at
fields.description: When the match was recorded.

indexes.name: slug
indexes.description: Finds the proposals one entry answered.

objects.description: One run of the routine that fills the catalog, and its own report of what it did.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers.

fields.name: run_ref
fields.description: The run's own identifier, as the routine knows it.

fields.name: submitted_by
fields.description: What reported it.

fields.name: templates_filed
fields.description: How many entries the run wrote.

fields.name: summary
fields.description: The run's own report of what it did.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When it was recorded.

indexes.name: created
indexes.description: Lists runs newest first.

objects.description: One run-time knob the routine reads, such as the rule it ranks the catalog by. A key/value store because knobs are added faster than a schema should change.

fields.name: key
fields.description: The setting's name.

fields.name: value
fields.description: Its current value.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: When it was last written.

objects.description: A running count for one page of the catalog.

fields.name: page
fields.description: Which kind of page was viewed: the front page, or one entry's.

fields.name: slug
fields.description: The entry viewed. Empty for the front page.

fields.name: views
fields.description: Running total. There are no per-day rows, so nothing here answers a question about a trend.

objects.description: One holder's latest values on one subject, as last sent, with the time of every change. A domain that keeps no records fills no object for this role.

fields.name: subject_id
fields.description: What the values are about, opaque to this module.

fields.name: holder_id
fields.description: Whose values these are, opaque to this module.

fields.name: scope_id
fields.description: Which of the holder's standings the values were sent under, opaque to this module; a holder sending under two keeps two records, each counted under its own. Empty when the host keeps one record per holder.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers, kept across every change.

fields.name: doc
fields.description: The holder's latest values, one key per field, replaced whole on every send.

fields.name: changes
fields.description: The time of every send, oldest first, the first one included.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the first values were sent.

fields.name: last_updated
fields.description: When the latest values were sent.

indexes.name: subject
indexes.description: Lists one subject's records and counts them.

objects.description: One holder's say that they share an item already raised, at most one per holder per item. A domain that counts no endorsements fills no object for this role.

fields.name: subject_id
fields.description: The item endorsed, opaque to this module.

fields.name: holder_id
fields.description: Who endorsed it, opaque to this module.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the holder first endorsed it.

indexes.name: subject
indexes.description: Counts one item's endorsements.

objects.description: One time a service is offered and how many holders it takes. A domain that books no times fills no object for this role.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, minted by the store.

fields.name: subject_id
fields.description: The service offered at this time, opaque to this module.

fields.name: starts_at
fields.description: When the time starts, RFC 3339 UTC.

fields.name: ends_at
fields.description: When the time ends, RFC 3339 UTC, after it starts.

fields.name: capacity
fields.description: How many holders one time takes, at least one.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the time was offered.

indexes.name: subject
indexes.description: Lists one service's times.

objects.description: One holder's place at one offered time, kept after a cancellation with who cancelled and why. A domain that books no times fills no object for this role.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, minted by the store.

fields.name: slot_id
fields.description: The time booked.

fields.name: subject_id
fields.description: The service of the time booked, copied when booked.

fields.name: holder_id
fields.description: Who booked, taken from the caller and never the body.

fields.name: day
fields.description: The calendar day of the time booked, YYYY-MM-DD in UTC, copied when booked.

fields.name: starts_at
fields.description: When the time booked starts, copied when booked.

fields.name: cancelled_at
fields.description: When the booking was cancelled, empty while it stands.

fields.name: cancelled_by
fields.description: Who cancelled it, the holder or a member of staff.

fields.name: cancel_reason
fields.description: Why it was cancelled; required when staff cancel.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the holder booked.

indexes.name: slot
indexes.description: Counts one time's standing bookings.

indexes.name: holder
indexes.description: Lists one holder's bookings.

indexes.name: day
indexes.description: Lists one day's bookings for staff.

objects.description: Something a holder raised for the mounting host to answer, by themselves or filed on their behalf. A domain that takes no raised items fills no object for this role.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, minted by the store.

fields.name: title
fields.description: What was raised, in the raiser's words, one line.

fields.name: topic
fields.description: What it is about, from the domain's own list, opaque to this module.

fields.name: publishable
fields.description: Whether the raiser agreed it may be shown to others; otherwise it stays between the raiser and the host.

fields.name: raised_by
fields.description: Whose item this is, opaque to this module.

fields.name: filed_by
fields.description: Who filed it on the raiser's behalf, empty when the raiser filed it.

fields.name: channel
fields.description: How it reached whoever filed it on the raiser's behalf, empty when the raiser filed it.

fields.name: pin
fields.description: The exact point the raiser dropped, when they dropped one. Only the raiser and the host's staff read it; every other read gets it rounded.

fields.name: address
fields.description: The place as the raiser typed it, empty when they typed none.

fields.name: area
fields.description: The host's area the item falls in. The one the raiser typed is kept; when none was typed it is resolved by the host from the pin, else the address; empty when none. Opaque to this module.

fields.name: area_mismatch
fields.description: The area the host resolved from the pin or address when it differs from the one the raiser typed, which is kept as it was; empty when they agree or nothing was resolved.

fields.name: street
fields.description: The street the item is on, resolved by the host from the typed address's matched street, else from the pin's address, else the one the raiser gave; empty when none. Shown with the area to every reader.

fields.name: department
fields.description: The department that holds the item, set by the routing setting from the topic when it is filed, or by an officer; empty when none. Opaque to this module.

fields.name: department_by
fields.description: Who set the department: rule when the routing setting did, officer when a person did, empty while none is set. An officer's choice is never replaced by a rule.

fields.name: board_item_id
fields.description: The board item this publishable item is grouped under, empty while ungrouped.

fields.name: subject_id
fields.description: The id of the entry in this catalog that the raiser is, when the raiser is known to it; empty means the raiser is not in it, and the item is an arrival tied to nobody.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When it was raised.

fields.name: follow_key_hash
fields.description: SHA-256 of the key that lets the raiser follow this item and the replies written to it without signing in, hex-encoded. Empty until a key is issued; the raw key is returned once and never stored, and issuing another retires this one.

indexes.name: raiser
indexes.description: Lists one raiser's items.

indexes.name: board_item
indexes.description: Counts and lists the items grouped under one board item.

indexes.name: subject
indexes.description: Lists the items raised by one entry's subject.

objects.description: One item on the public board, grouping the publishable raised items that say the same thing. A domain without a board fills no object for this role.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, minted by the store.

fields.name: title
fields.description: What the grouped items raise, one line, as the board shows it.

fields.name: outcome
fields.description: What came of it, public text, empty until there is one.

fields.name: hidden
fields.description: Whether staff have taken it off the public board; a hidden board item is left out of every public read and its share link stops opening.

fields.name: assignee_kind
fields.description: What assignee_id names: actor, a person named by the host's own id, or role, whose holders the host resolves and any of whom picks the item up. Empty means unassigned.

fields.name: assignee_id
fields.description: Who the item is assigned to, read as assignee_kind says, opaque to this module. Empty means unassigned.

fields.name: closed_at
fields.description: When it was closed, set once by an explicit Close and by nothing else. Empty while the item is open.

fields.name: closed_by
fields.description: Who closed it, the caller of Close, opaque to this module. Empty while the item is open.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When it was put on the board.

objects.description: An answer to a raised item, from whoever answers for the mounting host. A domain that sends no replies fills no object for this role.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, minted by the store.

fields.name: raised_item_id
fields.description: The raised item this answers.

fields.name: body
fields.description: The answer, as the raiser reads it.

fields.name: replied_by
fields.description: Who answered, opaque to this module.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When it was sent.

indexes.name: raised_item
indexes.description: Lists the replies to one raised item.

objects.description: A raised item taken off the board, with the ground it was taken down on, which its raiser reads. A domain that removes nothing fills no object for this role.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, minted by the store.

fields.name: raised_item_id
fields.description: The raised item taken down.

fields.name: ground
fields.description: Why it was taken down, as its raiser reads it.

fields.name: removed_by
fields.description: Who took it down, opaque to this module.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When it was taken down.

indexes.name: raised_item
indexes.description: Finds the removal of one raised item.

objects.description: One file attached to a raised item, held by its id in the file store the mounting host keeps. Seen by the raiser and by whoever answers for the host; seen by the public only once approved for publishing on a publishable item. A domain that takes no attachments fills no object for this role.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, minted by the store.

fields.name: raised_item_id
fields.description: The raised item the file is attached to.

fields.name: file_id
fields.description: The file's id in the host's file store, opaque to this module.

fields.name: attached_by
fields.description: Who attached it: the raiser, opaque to this module.

fields.name: attached_at
fields.description: When it was attached.

fields.name: approved_by
fields.description: Who approved it for publishing, opaque to this module; empty until approved.

fields.name: approved_at
fields.description: When it was approved for publishing; empty until approved.

indexes.name: raised_item_file
indexes.description: One file at most once per raised item.

objects.description: A dated, sourced figure about a scope, recorded from outside this module so a count of rows has a denominator beside it. Append-only; the newest by as_of is the current figure. A domain that keeps no figures fills no object for this role.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, minted by the store.

fields.name: scope_id
fields.description: The scope the figure is about, opaque to this module.

fields.name: value
fields.description: The figure itself, a whole number.

fields.name: as_of
fields.description: When the figure was true, as its source states it.

fields.name: source
fields.description: Where the figure came from, as a reader would cite it.

fields.name: recorded_by
fields.description: Who recorded it, opaque to this module.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When it was recorded.

indexes.name: scope
indexes.description: Reads one scope's figures, newest first.

settings.name: kinds
settings.description: The kinds an entry may name in its document's kind key, each with the fields its document carries: a name, a type (string, number, boolean, object or array) and whether it is required. An entry naming no kind, or a mount declaring none, is not checked.

settings.name: seeds
settings.description: The entries a mount starts with, each a slug, a name, an optional summary and an optional document object. Applying them creates every seed whose slug no entry holds, as pending like any new entry, and leaves an existing or deleted entry alone.

settings.name: catalogues
settings.description: Every catalogue the agency has, each a mount, a name, an audience (public, members or staff) and whether it holds services. Publishing makes each one exist; a mount not listed answers not found. The forms catalogue and the ideas board are built in and never listed.

settings.name: routing
settings.description: Which department holds a raised item: a default department and rules, each a topic and the department it goes to. An item filed with a topic a rule names goes to that department, any other goes to the default, and one an officer assigned is never moved by a rule.
